subject: ModernGate integration — registration bounty tiers & monthly reconciliation cadence
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@moderngate.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: ModernGate Partnerships <partnerships@moderngate.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ModernGate x Redwood — proposed registration bounty tiers + reconciliation cadence

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited about the connector and believe ModernGate customers will move quickly once we have a co-sell offer in-market. Attached is a first-pass on how we typically structure referral bounties and the lead registration template so finance can reconcile. Highlights: 

- Bounty tiers (one-time): 8% of first-year NRR for $0-$100k ACV, 6% for $100k-$500k, 4% > $500k.
- Lead registration window: 90 days from registration to conversion for bounty eligibility.
- Payment cadence: Net-60 after signed order and receipt of invoice + reconciliation statement.
- Clawback: pro-rated if customer churns inside 120 days.

Attachments: MG-Partner-SOW-draft.pdf (SOW template), ModernGate-Lead-Template.csv (sample registration CSV).

Before we ship to procurement we wanted to check:
1) Do these tier levels and a 90-day registration window work for Redwood?
2) Any mandatory contract clauses or caps we should follow (e.g., max per-account payout, exclusivity language)?
3) Can we align on a monthly reconciliation file format (we can adapt your template if needed)?

If helpful, I can send a short SOW + DocuSign link next week. Proposed onboarding call: week of Apr 20.

Best,
Jenna Park
Head of Partnerships, ModernGate
jenna@moderngate.io
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0122

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ModernGate x Redwood — proposed registration bounty tiers + reconciliation cadence

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear proposal and attachments. Short answers up-front: tiers look reasonable, but we have a couple of commercial guardrails and a request on the reconciliation format. See notes below.

Commercial questions / asks:
- Clawback: we prefer a 90-day clawback window (not 120). Can ModernGate accept pro-rated clawback within 90 days from the order effective date?
- Per-account cap: Redwood requires a per-account cap of $250k for any single payout event unless there's leadership approval. Can you confirm?
- Proof of intro: registration must include one of the following (email thread with prospect, signed NDA, or calendar invite with both parties) — can you incorporate that into your CSV?
- Exclusivity: Redwood does not offer exclusivity on platform integrations. Please mark the registration template accordingly.

Reconciliation and ops:
- Finance prefers monthly CSVs with these columns: HubSpot Deal ID, MG Registration ID, Redwood Account ID (if available), Signed Order Date, Net MRR/ARR, Invoice #, Payout Amount, Notes.
- Payment cadence: Net-45 is our standard for partner bounties; is ModernGate able to move from Net-60 to Net-45?

Next steps:
1) Camila and Ben — can you review the attached SOW and commission matrix and flag any legal/finance blockers?
2) Jenna — if you accept the 90-day clawback and per-account cap, we can update the SOW and send via DocuSign for signatures.
3) Schedule onboarding call Apr 21 or Apr 22 — CAMs and technical lead to join.

Thanks — look forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Alliances | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
Office: +1 (650) 555-0199

Internal notes / redlines for commercial ops (quick list):

1) Commission structuring:
   - Agree with tiered % bands but recommend we add a minimum payout threshold of $500 per registration to avoid micro-payments.
   - Add explicit definitions for "first-year NRR" (exclude one-time professional services).

2) Proof of intro / registration validity:
   - We should require that the registration entry include "first-touch date" and one supporting artifact (email thread or calendar invite).
   - Implement a 30-day claim dispute window after the registration is submitted; ModernGate has to provide supporting artifacts within that window or registration is void.

3) Payment & reconciliation ops:
   - Move to Net-45 as Lauren requested; finance will accept Net-45 with monthly reconciliation delivered by the 10th business day of the following month.
   - Require a monthly reconciliation file with line-item attach (Partner-Commission-Matrix.xlsx) that maps to Redwood invoice numbers for audit.

4) Clawback mechanics:
   - 90-day clawback window OK, but we should use pro-rata recoupment on a monthly basis rather than an all-or-nothing return.

5) Contractual caps & approvals:
   - Per-account cap of $250k without exec sign-off is standard. Anything above requires pipeline approval from Revenue Ops.

I marked changes in the attached Partner-Commission-Matrix.xlsx and added a sample reconciliation CSV row for the ModernGate-Lead-Template.csv.

Ben
Sr. Director, Channel Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
